04 / THE STORY

A little unconventional.
By design.

Why “Six7”?

Like “6–7”: you may not fully understand how it works, but you can feel its power. A playful name for a practical idea: business software that belongs to the business.

AN ENTANGLED FORGE PRODUCT DIVISION

Innovation through connection.

Six7 brings Entangled Forge’s approach to innovation into everyday business tools. Cross-company collaboration connects ideas, experience and practical needs to shape what we build.

Meet Entangled Forge ↗

Built by Gaston Fourcade, who wrote his father’s business systems in dBASE and Lotus 1-2-3, then led technology at Globant and Auna.

THE BUILD STORY

New ideas.
Seven-year-old hardware.

Built with Claude on Omarchy, using a repurposed seven-year-old notebook. A practical expression of doing more with what you already have.
